environment.qualification: Browser-level SystemInfo from a separate launch; not per-sample or per-context GPU attestation.

method: Local CPU1, 1440×900 and 390×900; no mobile touch/DPR emulation or network latency. Both settings change the shell theme, while each Stage retains its default metadata theme.
One fresh browser process for all 48 cases; an empty context per sample. First-process graphics initialization is not repeated for each route. OS caches and other user work are uncontrolled.

Heading and Stage paint values preserve the existing fonts/two-animation-frame proxies; they do not prove each complete photographic or GPU composition was visible at that instant. Assets-ready covers current DOM images and fonts only.

Graphics wrappers are diagnostics with added overhead, not replacement acceptance samples. Their call stacks identify executed application operations, without attributing all elapsed time to JavaScript or one browser subsystem.
